name: Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon (9th ed.)
short_description: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is a full-marathon event held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam on December 6, 2026, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is the 9th edition of this full-marathon event, scheduled for December 6, 2026 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It offers multiple distance options including 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km, and 1.5km, catering to a range of runner abilities. Registration is currently open for those interested in participating.

core_facts.venue: Le Duan - Nguyen Binh Khiem, Ho Chi Minh City

pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km, 1.5km) accommodate various runner levels
Registration is open until 6 November 2026, a month before race day
Carries a World Athletics label and full AIMS membership, so the course is properly measured
Central course past Notre-Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace, Ben Thanh Market and the Saigon River
cons: Pre-dawn start to manage heat and humidity, so most of the marathon is run in darkness
Field size approaching 18,000 makes for congested early kilometres in the shorter distances
research_highlights: Vietnam's largest and most established marathon, now in its 9th edition, organised by Sunrise Events.
The 7th edition drew a record field of nearly 18,000 runners from 64 countries and territories.
Listed as a full member of AIMS with M/H/R designation, and carries a World Athletics road race label.
The course is a road loop starting at Le Duan - Nguyen Binh Khiem, passing Notre-Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace, Ben Thanh Market and running along the Saigon River.
Registration for the 9th edition closes on 6 November 2026, a month ahead of the 6 December race date.
research_watchouts: Entry fees are tiered by registration phase and were not retrievable from the official fee page at the time of writing -- check marathonhcmc.com for the current tier before budgeting.
The official race website blocks automated access, so aggregator listings for this event cannot be cross-checked against it programmatically and may lag.

faqs.question: When is the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon taking place?
faqs.answer: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is scheduled to take place on December 6, 2026. This date marks the 9th edition of the race, which is held annually in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, drawing runners from various distance categories to participate in this international event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: This event offers six distance options for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, as well as shorter distances of 10km, 5km, 3km, and 1.5km, accommodating a wide range of runner experience levels and fitness goals.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is currently open. Interested participants can register ahead of the December 6, 2026 event date, allowing sufficient time to prepare for their chosen distance, whether it be the full marathon or one of the shorter race options.

faqs.question: Where is the marathon held?
faqs.answer: The marathon is held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, which serves as both the venue and host city for this international running event. As the 9th edition of the race, it continues to bring together runners from multiple distance categories in this major Vietnamese city.
